I'm checking if MPI is available, and planning a distributed Floyd-Warshall approach using row-block decomposition with a standard row-major indexing scheme for the distance matrix.\n\nFor the algorithm, each rank broadcasts the current row k before updating its local rows, since row k and column k stay fixed during step k given nonnegative unsigned distances with zero diagonal. This means broadcasting at the start of each step is mathematically equivalent to the sequential version, and I need to make sure the unsigned arithmetic doesn't overflow given the bounded edge weights.\n\nFor the path matrix, I'll keep updating it per-row for semantic equivalence even though it's not directly printed. At the end, I only need to gather the distance matrix (and path if needed) to rank 0 when printing or validating results, since the hash computation and validation sampling both happen on the root after gathering.\n\nFor random number generation, since rand_r with a fixed seed must produce identical results across ranks, the simplest approach is to have every rank generate the full n×n matrix sequentially and just keep its assigned rows, since the generation cost is negligible compared to the O(n³) computation.\n\nFor the row broadcasting step, each rank broadcasts its owned row at step k using MPI_Bcast, so over n steps there are n broadcasts totaling O(n² log p) communication against O(n³/p) computation, which could potentially overlap.\n\nI'm weighing whether to pipeline this with nonblocking Ibcast, prefetching row k+1 while computing k, but that requires the owner of row k+1 to finish updating it before posting the send — overlap is appealing but adds complexity, so I'll likely stick with blocking Bcast for simplicity first.\n\nThe owner updates row k+1 first before broadcasting it, and since every rank posts exactly one Ibcast per step, the collective ordering stays consistent across all ranks. The row k+1 update only needs local data and the current row buffer, so it can safely be copied into the next buffer right after.\n\nThinking about load balancing for uneven n/p splits, I need an owner function that maps each row to its rank using block ranges like floor(n*rank/p) to floor(n*(rank+1)/p), which handles the remainder rows correctly.\n\nFor the inner loop over j, keeping the row-major layout preserves contiguous access so it stays vectorizable, and I can make the min/update branchless so the compiler can auto-vectorize with min/blend instructions, updating both distance and path conditionally without branching.\n\nSince row k doesn't change during step k, I can safely use the buffered copy for rowk reads. I'll skip OpenMP and stick to MPI only to avoid adding extra dependencies.\n\nFor initialization, I need to replicate the exact rand_r sequence across the full n*n grid, keeping only the local rows on each rank, with the diagonal zeroed afterward—even at large n this should run quickly enough to be acceptable.\n\nWeighing alternatives: rank 0 generating and scattering the whole matrix would add significant communication overhead and demand full n^2 memory on one node, which isn't great for a distributed cluster. Having every rank independently redo the rand_r generation is redundant work, but it's simple, avoids communication, and is still cheap relative to the O(n^3) computation cost, so I'll stick with per-rank generation.\n\nNow I'm carefully untangling the indexing convention used in initializePathMatrix -- figuring out exactly which row/column each write touches so the path matrix initialization matches the original semantics.\n\nChecking consistency: dist(row i, col j) uses the same index mapping as path, so updated path(i,j)=k aligns with the row/column convention I derived for dist as well. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793068647373,"sessionID":"ses_e84c95de0ffeYym9juvWjlosfz","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01DmYGbuTUJRuQNSSfU7vy5t","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Block row distribution: rank p owns global rows [rowBegin(p), rowBegin(p + 1)).\ninline size_t rowBegin(const size_t p, const size_t numProcs, const size_t numNodes) noexcept {\n    return numNodes * p / numProcs;\n}\n\n// Generates the same random matrix as the sequential version (identical rand_r stream on\n// every rank), but stores only the rows [rowLo, rowHi) owned by this rank.\nvoid initializeLocalDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                                   const size_t rowLo, const size_t rowHi,\n                                   const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t total = numNodes * numNodes;\n    const size_t base = rowLo * numNodes;\n    const size_t end = rowHi * numNodes;\n\n    for (size_t g = 0; g < total; ++g) {\n        const unsigned int value = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n        if (g >= base && g < end) {\n            dist[g - base] = value;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = rowLo; i < rowHi; ++i) {\n        dist[(i - rowLo) * numNodes + i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path matrix entry (row r, column c) is initialized to r for all c.\nvoid initializeLocalPathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                               const size_t rowLo, const size_t rowHi) {\n    for (size_t i = rowLo; i < rowHi; ++i) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + (i - rowLo) * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(i));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes one locally owned row i against intermediate node k:\n//   dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j]), path[i][j] = k on improvement.\n// rowK is a private copy of row k, which is invariant during step k.\nstatic inline void relaxRow(unsigned int* __restrict distRow, unsigned int* __restrict pathRow,\n                            const unsigned int* __restrict rowK, const unsigned int distIK,\n                            const unsigned int k, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        const unsigned int newDist = distIK + rowK[j];\n        const unsigned int oldDist = distRow[j];\n        const bool better = newDist < oldDist;\n        distRow[j] = better ? newDist : oldDist;\n        pathRow[j] = better ? k : pathRow[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Distributed Floyd-Warshall over row blocks.\n// At step k, row k (and column k) is unchanged by the step, so the owner of row k\n// broadcasts it and every rank relaxes its own rows against that copy. The row for step\n// k+1 is relaxed first by its owner and sent with a non-blocking broadcast, which overlaps\n// communication with the local update of the remaining rows.\nvoid floydWarshallMPI(std::vector<unsigned int>& localDist,\n                      std::vector<unsigned int>& localPath,\n                      const size_t numNodes,\n                      const size_t rowLo,\n                      const size_t rowHi,\n                      const std::vector<int>& ownerOf,\n                      const MPI_Datatype rowType,\n                      const int rank) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t localRows = rowHi - rowLo;\n    std::vector<unsigned int> rowBuf[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(numNodes),\n                                           std::vector<unsigned int>(numNodes)};\n\n    // Row 0 for step 0.\n    if (ownerOf[0] == rank) {\n        std::copy_n(localDist.begin(), numNodes, rowBuf[0].begin());\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(rowBuf[0].data(), 1, rowType, ownerOf[0], MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int* cur = rowBuf[k & 1].data();\n        unsigned int* nxt = rowBuf[(k + 1) & 1].data();\n        const bool hasNext = (k + 1) < numNodes;\n        const int nextOwner = hasNext ? ownerOf[k + 1] : -1;\n\n        size_t relaxedLocal = localRows;  // sentinel: no row already relaxed this step\n        MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n\n        if (hasNext) {\n            if (nextOwner == rank) {\n                const size_t li = (k + 1) - rowLo;\n                unsigned int* distRow = localDist.data() + li * numNodes;\n                unsigned int* pathRow = localPath.data() + li * numNodes;\n                relaxRow(distRow, pathRow, cur, distRow[k], static_cast<unsigned int>(k), numNodes);\n                std::copy_n(distRow, numNodes, nxt);\n                relaxedLocal = li;\n            }\n            MPI_Ibcast(nxt, 1, rowType, nextOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n        }\n\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < localRows; ++li) {\n            if (li == relaxedLocal) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            unsigned int* distRow = localDist.data() + li * numNodes;\n            unsigned int* pathRow = localPath.data() + li * numNodes;\n            relaxRow(distRow, pathRow, cur, distRow[k], static_cast<unsigned int>(k), numNodes);\n        }\n\n        if (hasNext) {\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int numProcs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numProcs);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank, so all ranks agree on the exit path)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI processes: %d\\n\", numProcs);\n    }\n\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(numProcs);\n    const size_t R = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t rowLo = rowBegin(R, P, numNodes);\n    const size_t rowHi = rowBegin(R + 1, P, numNodes);\n    const size_t localRows = rowHi - rowLo;\n\n    // Row datatype: one row of numNodes unsigned ints, used for broadcasts and gathers\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    // Owner rank of each global row\n    std::vector<int> ownerOf(numNodes);\n    for (int p = 0; p < numProcs; ++p) {\n        const size_t pb = rowBegin(static_cast<size_t>(p), P, numNodes);\n        const size_t pe = rowBegin(static_cast<size_t>(p) + 1, P, numNodes);\n        for (size_t r = pb; r < pe; ++r) {\n            ownerOf[r] = p;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Allocate local blocks of the matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> localDist(localRows * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> localPath(localRows * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    }\n    initializeLocalDistanceMatrix(localDist, numNodes, rowLo, rowHi, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializeLocalPathMatrix(localPath, numNodes, rowLo, rowHi);\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    floydWarshallMPI(localDist, localPath, numNodes, rowLo, rowHi, ownerOf, rowType, rank);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        const long long durationMs = static_cast<long long>(maxElapsed * 1000.0);\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate operations per second\n        // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n        const double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n        const double gflops = ops / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n\n    // Results and validation need the full matrix on the root\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<unsigned int> fullDist;\n        std::vector<int> counts(numProcs);\n        std::vector<int> displs(numProcs);\n        for (int p = 0; p < numProcs; ++p) {\n            const size_t pb = rowBegin(static_cast<size_t>(p), P, numNodes);\n            const size_t pe = rowBegin(static_cast<size_t>(p) + 1, P, numNodes);\n            counts[p] = static_cast<int>(pe - pb);\n            displs[p] = static_cast<int>(pb);\n        }\n        if (root) {\n            fullDist.resize(numNodes * numNodes);\n        }\n        MPI_Gatherv(localDist.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), rowType,\n                    fullDist.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (printResults && root) {\n            print_results_int(fullDist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n        }\n\n        if (validate) {\n            int valid = 0;\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n                valid = validateResult(fullDist, numNodes) ? 1 : 0;\n                if (valid) {\n                    printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n                } else {\n                    printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                }\n            }\n            MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            exitCode = valid ? 0 : 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return exitCode;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r4/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","time":{"start":1793068647278,"end":1793068647337}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17b381278001XZAsAWTK88ar8g","sessionID":"ses_e84c95de0ffeYym9juvWjlosfz","messageID":"msg_17b37918c001Rg2VeEXcBY40uP"}}
